prompts.title: Improve Tasks Visualization
prompts.content:
In the extension, we need to improve the Task visualization.

1- Move the status pill ex:"TODO" to the next line, underneath the Task title. in the same line, show the status drop drown and then the feature style dropdown.
So they are all in the same line right underneath the task title.

2-To the right of the task title, we should add the X red button to delete the task and prompts.

3-The button Queue should also be in the line unerneath the title. right after the feature style dropdown.

4-After the "+Queue" button, we need to add a "+'NoteIcon'" a + with the NoteIcon or file icon next to it. this should be the add reference button, so you can remove the one bellow.

5-PROMPT REFERENCES section should only show up if there are references added.

6- Same for Acceptand Criteria. Only show the section if there are any. The Acceptance Criteria add button should be the last one on the second line, right after the +NoteIcon button. it should say "+AC"
